correspondences.notes: Closest BIDS file is events.tsv, but this is an MNE FIF annotation, not a BIDS file.

brainlife.desc: MNE-Python annotations (onset, duration, description) saved as annotation.fif, e.g. bad segments or events.
brainlife.name: neuro/meeg/mne/raw/annotation
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Carrying bad-segment or event annotations to add to MNE raw data.

**Not for:** Processing on brainlife.io: no App reads or writes this datatype.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meeg.mne.raw.annotation.json

governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level event metadata linkable through a participant code.
sharing_cautions: Review description text and orig_time before sharing.
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if descriptions contain names or exact dates.

intended_use: Carrying bad-segment or event annotations to add to MNE raw data.
